name: Amy Salovaara
original_name: アミィ サロヴァーラ
source:
Lulu's roommate and best friend. She's a kind-hearted girl who knows a lot about astronomy. She's quite shy about her feelings, but she opens up to Lulu after the two know each other better.

[Edited from [url=http://wand-of-fortune.wikia.com/wiki/Amy_Salovaara]WOF Wikia[/url]]
